info.title: Cloudflare Browser Run Universal API
info.description: Cloudflare Browser Run, formerly Browser Rendering, runs headless Chrome on Cloudflare's global network for Quick Actions, browser sessions, screenshots, PDFs, markdown extraction, crawling, and DevTools automation.
